android.desc:
The Spine Viewer app offers user to load and manipulate Spine skeletal animation within phone. The viewer app is optimised for mobile device and provide best performance.
It can be useful for testing how skeleton data exported from Spine and rendered on android.
Pack your export data into ZIP and pick the file via explorer from the app. It'll be copyied and extracted to internal storage of the app, after that opened. Every picked file adds to database and can be fast loaded from the list on the main screen.

Features:
- work with Spine Skeleton Data 3.5, 3.6, 3.7, 3.8, 4.0, 4.1, 4.2 and 4.3
- play animation
- choose skin
- combine skin
- live search for skin combine
- zoom/pan
- hide UI
- export to gif

quotes.text: If you need to check your spine skeleton on android device - there's a free app Spine Viewer https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spineviewer
quotes.story_title: Spine – 2D skeletal animation for games, with physical secondary motions
